unattributable: This measurement cannot be assigned to a model. It was written on 2026-08-31 when two 52M checkpoints existed -- latin-lii-latinitas (the surviving single phase, 21.3) and what is now latin-lii-romanitas (the abandoned narrowing run, 32.5 on this corpus) -- and evaluate.py scored a text file without recording which one wrote it. Timestamps do not settle it: both checkpoints predate the report. Kept rather than deleted because the measurement itself is sound; renamed so its filename stops implying an attribution it cannot support. evaluate.py now takes --sampled-from so this cannot recur, and a re-measurement against latin-lii-latinitas is recorded in memorization-latin-lii-latinitas.json.
